essence: The supreme offering is the sudden dissolution of gross forms into the blazing light of awareness.
Entities offered into awareness both lose their separateness and intensify the fire of awareness by their own power.
Any sense-object freely manifested by the creative nature of consciousness is fit to serve as an object of meditation.
Within formless, all-form consciousness, a particular form is posited as the meditation object for result-seeking practitioners.
Seeking a particular form within nondual fullness is analogous to choosing a pot to fetch water without denying the fullness of reality.
